examples.title: Isavuconazole for the Prevention of COVID-19-associated Pulmonary Aspergillosis

summary: Official warnings note that serious liver problems have occurred, so tests are needed to check liver health before and during use of the drug [3]. Reactions related to receiving the medicine directly into a vein have also been reported [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a high score for liver issues and a low score for heart issues [M].
